prompt: Paint a 1914 Northern European Expressionist street scene, wide horizontal composition compressed carefully into a square canvas. A crowd of male workers approaches the viewer along a cobbled village street. Three oversized foreground figures dominate: at left a pale man in a light gray-blue jacket and broad dark hat; center a grim-faced mustached worker wearing a dark cap and vivid cobalt-blue coat; lower right a close, downward-looking man in a brown coat and dark cap. Behind them numerous blurred blue-black figures recede into the distance, flanked by pale buildings and low yellow-brown walls under a cloudy pale sky. Distorted faces with green shadows, angular walking poses, rough swirling cobalt, violet and ochre strokes, uneven impasto, aged canvas.
